Note: BC populates a window of rows when a list opens (a failing row 3 to 20 of 120 fails OpenView; row 25 and row 30 do not), and a later move that populates a new window raises the expression's own error. The runner evaluates the current row's AutoFormatExpression/CaptionClass expressions only (RunnerPageInstance.EvaluateRowExpressions, called from LiveNavTestPage.Loaded).
